title: 主服务不可用时仍能远程恢复
summary: 保留为独立的 Recovery 用户需求。源码继续位于 monorepo，但安装后使用自包含不可变发布、独立 launchd、独立状态、独立公网入口和独立 tunnel，不依赖主 Gateway、Daemon、active runtime 或 worktree。实现由主运行时稳定性需求统一定义边界。
goals: Preserve monorepo source ownership for Supervisor and standalone Recovery.
Install Recovery Gateway and Watchdog as self-contained immutable versioned artifacts with atomic activation.
Keep Recovery Gateway, Recovery Watchdog and recovery tunnel as separate OS service units from Primary runtime services.
Persist Recovery Watchdog state and prevent repeated noisy degraded loops or repeated rollback after watchdog restart.
Probe and repair the dedicated Recovery public endpoint independently from the primary MCP endpoint.
Remain usable when the repository checkout, Primary Gateway, Controller Daemon and active runtime are unavailable.
nonGoals: Do not make Recovery depend on the primary Gateway, Controller Daemon, active runtime instance, repository worktree or Bun at runtime.
Do not let Supervisor supervise Recovery Gateway or Recovery Watchdog; launchd/systemd remains their common lower-level authority.
Do not allow arbitrary shell execution or let Recovery mint/write primary runtime authority.
Do not preserve or extend the old long-lived blue/green slot model for compatibility.
Do not create a separate Recovery Git repository.
acceptanceCriteria: Recovery source remains under the repo-harness repository and is built from a clean canonical revision.
Installed Recovery artifacts live under versioned immutable release directories and activate atomically.
Recovery Gateway and Recovery Watchdog cold-start successfully without the repository worktree, primary Gateway, Controller Daemon or active runtime.
Both Recovery services restart after abnormal exit and remain stopped after an explicit authorized unload.
A dedicated recovery cloudflared service exposes only the Recovery endpoint and is independently repairable.
Watchdog separately evaluates local primary state, primary public endpoint, local Recovery Gateway and public Recovery endpoint.
Watchdog state survives restart and rollback/tunnel-repair actions remain idempotent, identity-scoped and rate-limited.
Recovery cannot mutate primary runtime authority and exposes only bounded verify/restart/rollback/cleanup operations.
Focused unit, smoke, launchd template, interrupted-install and tunnel-failure tests pass.
relatedArtifacts: dedicated Recovery tunnel and watchdog requirements

tasks.title: Define recovery authority and failure-domain contract
tasks.objective: Add or update architecture decisions documenting monorepo source ownership, immutable installed artifacts, OS-level service ownership, and the four distinct monitoring layers.
acceptanceCriteria: The document explicitly distinguishes Supervisor monitor, Recovery Watchdog, Gateway KeepAlive, and workflow watchdog.
The document forbids circular Supervisor-to-Recovery ownership.
notes: Wait for ISS-20260802-539E7F:T1 target architecture and deletion map. This Issue remains the standalone Recovery delivery line, not an independent architecture authority. Reuse the monorepo-source/installed-independence requirement and remove assumptions that preserve the old long-lived blue/green model.
Blocked on ISS-20260802-539E7F:T1. Recovery remains the delivery line but cannot define a competing architecture before the target process/state/config/deletion map is frozen.

tasks.title: Version and atomically activate Recovery artifacts
tasks.objective: Replace flat in-place Recovery binary installation with immutable release directories, manifest verification, and atomic current activation while retaining bounded cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Interrupted installation cannot corrupt the active Recovery release.
Launch service definitions reference a stable atomic activation path.
Previous verified Recovery release remains available for bounded fallback.

tasks.title: Persist and harden Recovery Watchdog state
tasks.objective: Persist failure counters, first-failure timestamps, rollback-used state, tunnel cooldowns, and last decision across Watchdog restarts; debounce repeated degraded logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Watchdog restart does not reset an active failure window or allow repeated rollback.
Repeated unchanged degraded decisions are rate-limited while state remains queryable.
Healthy verification clears only the appropriate failure class.

tasks.title: Add dedicated Recovery endpoint and tunnel supervision
tasks.objective: Separate primary and Recovery public endpoint configuration, generate a dedicated cloudflared service contract, probe the local/public Recovery endpoint, and repair only the failed tunnel.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary tunnel failure cannot restart or roll back the application runtime.
Recovery tunnel failure cannot restart the primary Gateway.
Recovery public reachability is verified independently from primary MCP reachability.
Tunnel repair targets an explicitly configured dedicated service label.

tasks.title: Verify self-recovery and failure isolation
tasks.objective: Add focused tests and smoke drills covering Supervisor failure, Recovery Gateway failure, Watchdog failure, primary tunnel failure, Recovery tunnel failure, and concurrent operation deferral.
acceptanceCriteria: Each failure recovers only its owner component.
No failure scenario produces a restart storm or duplicate rollback.
Recovery remains reachable while the primary Gateway is unavailable.
